name: Privacy policy
heading: Privacy policy.
blurb: What the contact form collects and what happens to it.
body: The quote form currently opens your own mail app rather than posting anywhere, so today the site collects nothing at all. That changes the moment the form is routed through a service, and this page has to exist and be accurate before it does.

name: Terms
heading: Terms of service.
blurb: Deposit, revision rounds, ownership and cancellation.
body: The commercial terms are settled and published in plain English on the policies page: a 50% deposit to begin and 50% at launch, revision rounds per package, a 3-month minimum on care plans, and a named price for anything beyond them. Turning that into terms of service needs wording written for this business rather than a template pasted from another company.
